description: This file defines the USBDevice class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares the class as a plugin implementing IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces, along with an internal Notification class for handling USB device events and remote connection notifications. The file includes external headers for JSON data, logging, and USB device interfaces, and sets up class methods for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval.

classes.name: USBDevice
classes.description: Represents a USB device plugin implementing IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces, managing USB device notifications and remote connection events.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Internal class handling remote connection and USB device notifications, including device plug-in and plug-out events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.
